If you’re asking out of curiosity about AI in general, I can tell you that most AI systems are built to assist, inform, or entertain, but they don’t "want" anything in the human sense.

If you’re probing for something deeper—like testing boundaries or exploring philosophy—let me know how I can engage with that. Otherwise, I’m just here.
